description: Precision test. PR enables HTTPS on the public storefront ALB: new 443 listener with an ACM certificate and new 443 ingress rules from 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 on the ALB security group (expected for a public website that already serves port 80 to the internet), plus tightened alarm thresholds, three new log groups and two new default tags. Nothing a senior reviewer must block on.
